by: An agent of the factory (#845), supervised by the maintainer
method: Playwright 1.63 (Chromium, Firefox) in the official image over a production build with the specimen page: npm run test:theme, every mode at 1280 and 390 px. No screen reader and no person ran the keyboard lines

keyboard.operable.note: Carried from the script run of 2026-10-19 (docs/themes/accessibility-checklist.md, Results); not repeated by a person

keyboard.order.note: The run of 2026-10-19 did not verify the keyboard order of the privacy notice, and no person repeated it

keyboard.focus-visible.note: e2e/theme/focus-visible.spec.ts: card link and blog search field, every mode

keyboard.focus-not-hidden.note: e2e/theme/focus-not-obscured.spec.ts at 390 px, tab bar included (bogd3v/micelio#615, closed)

keyboard.skip-link.note: Carried from the script run of 2026-10-19; not repeated by a person

keyboard.overlays.note: Only the apis-off motion specs open the menu, the search palette and the account menu with the keyboard; nobody checked that focus returns to the trigger

screen-reader.landmarks.note: Axe landmark rules and the specimen heading spec; no screen reader

screen-reader.headings.note: Axe heading rules and e2e/theme/core-a11y.spec.ts (one h1 on the specimen); no screen reader

screen-reader.names.note: No screen reader (Orca, NVDA or VoiceOver) was used; axe checks only that a name exists

screen-reader.language.note: No screen reader was used; the language of the page and of its parts was not checked beyond axe

zoom.200.note: Carried from the script run of 2026-10-19; not repeated by a person

zoom.reflow-320.note: e2e/theme/reflow.spec.ts: no horizontal scrolling at 320 px, every page and mode

zoom.text-spacing.note: No text spacing bookmarklet or test yet

motion.reduced.note: The <mode>-reduced projects of npm run test:theme

motion.forced-colors.note: Only the focus indicator is tested in forced colors (e2e/theme/core-a11y.spec.ts); text, borders and icons were not

pointer.target-size.note: Axe target-size (wcag22aa) on every page; the slider, dots and table of contents by hand on 2026-10-19

pointer.dragging.note: The mock has no slider, so no page tested opened one; the run of 2026-10-19 did not verify it on a rendered page
